title: Localized base-derived tensor comparison under compatible coefficient isomorphisms
statement: Let R0,A0,B0,C0 and R,A,B,C be commutative rings of the same universe, with R-algebra structures on A and B and an (A tensor_R B)-algebra structure on C, and likewise for the subscript-0 rings. Choose derived categories of R0,B0,R,B modules. Let Q0,Q be complexes over A0,A and M,N be their base-derived tensor cohomology models [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Suppose ring isomorphisms eR,eA,eB,eC commute with both base algebra maps and both maps from A and B to C. Suppose alpha is an isomorphism of the underlying additive input complexes, semilinear over eA, and tau is an isomorphism of the additive ordinary C-tensor complexes, sending c0 tensor q0 to eC(c0) tensor alpha(q0) in each degree. In every degree there exists an additive isomorphism l of the two C-extended model cohomology objects such that the localized comparison for M, the inverse exact forgetful homology factor, homology of tau, and the forward forgetful homology factor equal l followed by the localized comparison for N. No flatness or invertibility of the comparison is assumed.

source.place: more-algebra.tex, lemma-derived-base-change (Tag 06Y6); perfect.tex, equation-bc (Tag 0DJ7), coefficient transport in original ordinary-comparison plan steps 1 and 2.

proof.text: Restriction along eR and eB gives inverse exact module equivalences. The R-algebra map equations identify the two extension functors on generators. Transport their universal left-derived functors and counits; uniqueness of left-derived functors yields the counit-compatible identification.

Apply cohomologyIso to the transported derived input isomorphism. Semilinearity of alpha and naturality for multiplication, followed by cohomologyIso_smul, identify the A action. B-linearity identifies the B action. Tensor induction gives semilinearity for the tensor-ring isomorphism. Extend this isomorphism to C using the two C-map equations and forget scalars to construct l.

Use comparison_eq to identify the ordinary comparison with the transported counit. Transpose localized_eq through scalar-extension adjunction. The resulting ordinary chain map has tau's given formula on pure tensors, hence equals tau by tensor induction. Exact forgetful homology factors yield the asserted square.

theorem exists_baseDerivedTensor_ring_transport
    {R₀ A₀ B₀ C₀ R A B C : Type u}
    [CommRing R₀] [CommRing A₀] [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R₀ A₀] [Algebra R₀ B₀] [Algebra (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) C]
    [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R₀)] [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B₀)]
    [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)] [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (Q₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A₀) ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (M : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R₀ A₀ B₀ Q₀ C₀)
    (N : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q C)
    (eR : R₀ ≃+* R) (eA : A₀ ≃+* A) (eB : B₀ ≃+* B) (eC : C₀ ≃+* C)
    (hRA : eA.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R₀ A₀) =
      (algebraMap R A).comp eR.toRingHom)
    (hRB : eB.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R₀ B₀) =
      (algebraMap R B).comp eR.toRingHom)
    (hCA : eC.toRingHom.comp
        ((algebraMap (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀).comp (algebraMap A₀ (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀))) =
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).comp eA.toRingHom)
    (hCB : eC.toRingHom.comp ((algebraMap (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀).comp
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom) =
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).comp eB.toRingHom)
    (α : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} A₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q₀ ≅
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} A) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
    (hα : ∀ (i : ℤ) (a : A₀) (q : Q₀.X i),
      α.hom.f i (a • q) = eA a • (show Q.X i from α.hom.f i q))
    (τ :
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} C₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((extendScalars ((algebraMap (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀).comp
          (algebraMap A₀ (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q₀) ≅
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} C) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp
          (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
    (hτ : ∀ (i : ℤ) (c : C₀) (q : Q₀.X i),
      τ.hom.f i (c ⊗ₜ[A₀,(algebraMap (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀).comp
          (algebraMap A₀ (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀))] q) =
        eC c ⊗ₜ[A,(algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp
          (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))] (show Q.X i from α.hom.f i q))
    (i : ℤ) :
    let F₀ := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} C₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} C) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let T₀ := ((extendScalars ((algebraMap (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀).comp
      (algebraMap A₀ (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q₀
    let T := ((extendScalars ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q
    ∃ l : F₀.obj ((extendScalars (algebraMap (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀)).obj (M.cohomology i)) ≅
        F.obj ((extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj (N.cohomology i)),
      F₀.map (M.localizedComparison i) ≫ ((T₀.sc i).mapHomologyIso F₀).inv ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ.hom i ≫ ((T.sc i).mapHomologyIso F).hom =
      l.hom ≫ F.map (N.localizedComparison i)
